==Linguistic formalities==

Technically, one of Birgitte's titles would be ''gaidar'', comprised of the Old Tongue elements ''gai'' meaning "(of) battle", and ''dar'', "sister, woman, feminine, of womanhood". Compare how ''gaidin'' and ''saidin'' go together. ''Saidar'' and ''gaidar'' make as much sense, don't they? It makes me sad that we didn't see this make it into the actual books.

[[User:ASisterOfTheBlue|ASisterOfTheBlue]] ([[User talk:ASisterOfTheBlue|talk]]) 15:23, September 2, 2013 (UTC)

== Other incarnations ==

Could she and Gaidal Cain have been a Romeo and Juliet in some turning? In the first meeting between her and Nynaeve, she mentions that she almost always hates Gaidal and then usually marries/falls in love. That could loosely be a Romeo and Juliet story. And... well yall know how it goes, "Ages come and pass, leaving memories that become legend. Legend fades to myth, and even myth is long forgotten when the Age that gave it birth comes again."
